honored_joint_support.reason: RWARE can cancel conflicting movement requests; resolved tuples must be probed

intervention_authority.reason: requires a runtime match between requested and post-resolution executed actions

learned_policy_hook.reason: training can wrap the adapter, but no claim-specific endogenous learner hook is exposed here

message_deletion.reason: no standardized message-deletion intervention in the current adapter

mixed_difference_testable.reason: only on a verified full-product request/receipt panel; canceled cells must not be silently treated as executed

valid_action_mask.reason: adapter exposes an explicit per-agent mask

DYNAMIC.reason: only restricted until a claim-specific learned-policy update hook is exercised

MASTER_support.reason: requires a pre-execution joint command-feasibility oracle; post-execution cancellation/honoring is diagnostic only

QUERY.reason: core response queries require clone/restore plus a trusted executed-action receipt; unsupported query types remain NA

information_intervention.reason: requires an explicit information object and available-vs-absent intervention contract

capability_runtime.semantic_warning: requestable command support and resolved/honored support are different objects; never relabel post-conflict cancellation as pre-execution infeasibility

execution_semantics_definition: A cell counts as executed only when the ENTIRE requested joint action vector was executed, intervened and frozen-baseline coordinates alike. Source-only agreement is reported separately and does not establish F(a_S, a_baseline_-S).

response_estimand_definition: Q^(1)_j(a) = r_outcome(s, a_j, a_-j^baseline): the reward of a SINGLE environment step after a clone-state intervention. This is NOT a continuation return Q^(h,rho) = E[sum_t gamma^t r_t | do(A_j = a), rho]. The oracle can compute a continuation return (CloneStateJointOracle(horizon=h, discount=gamma, continuation_policy=...)), but this protocol does not, and no artifact it writes may be read as one.
